methods.label: Use corresponding angles and the angle sum
methods.explanation: Corresponding angles of similar polygons are equal, so \(\angle D'=\angle D\). The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is \(360^\circ\), so \(\angle D=360^\circ-80^\circ-95^\circ-100^\circ=85^\circ\).
